checkpoint_rule: fixed final one-pass; no target arrays or selection
scope: Source-only normal-mechanism neural probe, not TimeRCD integration or proof of TSAD improvement
primary: paired source-system normal NLL, full and predeclared context-ready point sets
context_ready: at least128 prior context points; set by indices, not anomaly labels
extra_forward: initial/final source normal+observed AP and source-normal cross-system-context swap; cache context uses counted separately
stop_expansion: No automatic extra lr/epochs. Interpret source NLL, observed AP and context swap before any target testing. No universal AUC gate.
